evidence_limits.note: All authored techsets are example packages. decompiled/techsetdef contains decompiled HLSL and ASM grouped by techset family, not literal techset source definitions.
evidence_limits.policy: Parser behavior may be derived from authored examples. Runtime binding and interface behavior may be derived from optimized ASM reflection tables. Category, render-state, and inheritance rules not present in authored techsets remain unsupported or warnings rather than guessed.

syntax_observed.aliases: Technique("lit", "unlit") syntax is required by generated packages although it is not present in the three authored corpus examples; all listed names must resolve to one technique body.
syntax_observed.source_precedence: Observed patterns require stage-local source to override technique source; otherwise stage source inherits technique source. A stage with a named generic base inherits that base before applying local fields.

conclusions: Optimized bytecode contains the authoritative live resource and signature interface; source declarations alone over-report optimized-out resources.
A resource name does not imply one global slot: colorMap and CodeTexture-style names appear at different t-slots across compiled variants.
Fullscreen/post-processing families do not share one universal interface or resource template.
VS/PS semantic matching must compare semantic name, index, component mask, and scalar kind while treating system-value semantics appropriately.
Texture dimensions include 2D, arrays, 3D, cube/cube arrays, structured buffers, and multisampled resources; unsupported dimensions must not be silently treated as Texture2D.

source_path_findings.examples_install_root: Each example is documented as copied into the BO3 root directory.
source_path_findings.known_previewer_finding: A custom PostFX shader using stock postfx includes failed under shaders_stable/_custom and succeeded at shaders_stable root. This remains a proven generated-package validation rule, not a universal ban on subfolders.
source_path_findings.runtime_toolsgfx_rule: Stable and stable_toolsgfx are separate package roots. Identical techset source may resolve differently under TOOLSGFX, and custom HLSL may be duplicated, omitted, or replaced by a stock editor source.

render_state_findings.confidence: Token presence and inheritance are proven. Exact D3D blend/depth/cull mappings are not present in the archive and must remain Unknown until separately proven.

single_sources_of_truth: one compiled reflection representation for VS and PS

validation_order: validate stage resources against resolved techset
validate VS output against PS input
decide package status and preview availability

current_previewer_gaps_at_audit: PostFX package validation is a main.cpp-local source-regex check rather than a parsed package model.
Runtime reflection checks only selected PS resource names and does not expose a reusable VS/PS interface model.
Techsets are generated by concatenating strings and are not parsed or resolved for preview.
Technique aliases, inheritance, defines append, stage inheritance, source override, and shader-local bindings are not resolved as a package.
TOOLSGFX/runtime preview contexts exist, but techset conditional resolution does not drive them.
No unified compiled cbuffer/constant/signature/resource representation is shared by preview and export.
No package-level VS output to PS input validation gates preview.
Material and sky export are not yet validated through the same package pipeline.
unsupported_or_uncertain_after_audit: Universal techset grammar beyond the observed subset
External include contents and inheritance bases not shipped in the corpus
Exact BO3 severity for techset parameters optimized out of a compiled stage
Exact engine CodeTexture name/type registry beyond names evidenced by authored examples or compiled shaders
Exact D3D render-state mapping for BO3 state tokens
Generic shader entry-point selection rules inside BO3 tooling
Full material register-token to APE field mapping
Whether every stock include supports every nested source path
